Medium full portrait framing at eye level, 85mm lens at f/4, focus held on the eyes, sash, embroidered bodice, and nearest hand, with gilded wall panels, framed artwork, and dark furnishings easing into a mild background blur; restrained palette of silver blue, ivory, pearl, muted gold, and warm mahogany, natural skin texture, crisp lace detail, subtle silk sheen, and smooth highlight rolloff.
